acquisition.candidate: H=64 times expected increase in maximum posterior-mean action utility, divided by forecast paid-marginal feedback tokens; stop when H*EVSI <= lambda*forecast_tokens
acquisition.free_controls: fixed methods receive no I/C and pay none; maintenance controls all pay the same I bank
acquisition.ordinary_EVSI: same current service prices and predictor, fixed base+counterfactual price instead of already-paid marginal closure price
acquisition.q_order: next unused per-edge C slot, except fixed periodic q=0,2,4,6 with U/V each
acquisition.tie_break: keep then U then V for actions; U then V for acquisition

budget.prefix: Two questions per worker; no quality read; release only if 1.5x full elapsed projection stays within worker cap minus60s

cost.I_C_cache: Deduplicate only exact requests within actually purchased I/C bundles; evaluator-generated cache confers no free observations
cost.feedback_oracle: Benchmark gold; monetary/human acquisition cost unknown, not imputed as zero
cost.primary_utility: S mean exact match - 0.005 * all I+C+S tokens / (1000*64)
report: I/C/S by model tokens, kernel seconds, calls
cost.service_cache: Each service graph pays every executed node; no discount from global experimental cache
cost.weight_is: Declared development tradeoff; not monetary cost or externally justified willingness to pay

hypothesis: Current terminal-ancestor service costs and already-paid feedback closure costs improve decision-value revalidation on a common full-context DAG, beyond generic VOI and zero-feedback structural controls.
new_regime_not_old_candidate_rescue: All active agents observe all raw documents; exact dead-node elimination is shared by every method; old G2/D2/D3/R1/formal2/formal4 failures unchanged.
no_change_control: Repeat same fixed policies on G0 C/S; no graph change flag. DELETE_CHANGED/OTHER names map U/V for no-change only. Primary gate uses change condition only.
policy_seed: generation_seed + 1000; five generation seeds are repeated measurements, not five independent datasets

predictor.update: Add only purchased C outcome counts; no S argument to policy

primary_gates_conjunction.independent3_Q: accuracy difference >= -0.01 AND complete token ratio <=0.90
primary_gates_conjunction.random_seed_support: positive utility difference in at least four of five generation seeds
primary_gates_conjunction.utility_gain_over_each: at least +0.005 vs random, periodic, uncertainty, stale, protect_changed, EVSI_fixed_price, KEEP_NO_INIT, DELETE_CHANGED_NO_INIT, DELETE_OTHER_NO_INIT

service_price_forecast: I mean G0 / G0-minus-U / G0-minus-V tokens; subtract mean I cost of disconnected source only for its G1 direct-edge deletion. No new C/S unpurchased costs are used. It is a forecast, not exact future cost.
statistics: Question-disjoint episodes are independent sampling units; report eight episode and five seed point decompositions. Gates are empirical development filters, not significance or population noninferiority.

stopping.candidate_failure: Any primary gate fails: STOP_FORMAL5_CANDIDATE; do not promote a control or adjust weights/thresholds
stopping.candidate_pass: Only retain same frozen method for independent confirmation; no paper success. Require fresh Hotpot reproduction plus a second task with five seeds before positive final claims.
stopping.conditional_confirmation_scope: Same algorithm and utility fixed; new task adapter and independent inputs must be preregistered before their outcomes. No substantive sixth algorithm candidate.
stopping.project: After fifth completed candidate, no sixth candidate under current authorization; preserve negative results and finish audit/manuscript. GPU cap remains 160 without reset.
